arxiv-1708-07875.title: Search for the direct production of charginos and neutralinos in final states with tau leptons in s = 13 ​ TeV \sqrt{s}=13\,\mathrm{TeV} p ​ p pp collisions with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1708-07875.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1708-07875.description: Abstract A search for the direct production of charginos and neutralinos in final states with at least two hadronically decaying tau leptons is presented. The analysis uses a dataset of p ​ p pp collisions corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 36.

arxiv-2108-09492.title: Local Solubility of Hyperelliptic Curves
arxiv-2108-09492.creator: Omri Faraggi
arxiv-2108-09492.description: Abstract . We give a condition for a hyperelliptic curve C C over a local field K K to be locally soluble, on the condition that C C obtains semistable reduction after a tame extension of K K , and that the residue field k k is sufficiently large relative to the genus of the curve.

arxiv-2205-14540.title: SupMAE: Supervised Masked Autoencoders Are Efficient Vision Learners
arxiv-2205-14540.creator: Feng Liang Yangguang Li Diana Marculescu
arxiv-2205-14540.description: Abstract Recently, self-supervised Masked Autoencoders (MAE) ( He et al. 2021 ) have attracted unprecedented attention for their impressive representation learning ability. However, the pretext task, Masked Image Modeling (MIM), reconstructs the missing local patches, lacking the global understanding of the image.

arxiv-2206-14855.title: SoK: Content Moderation in Social Media, from Guidelines to Enforcement, and Research to Practice
arxiv-2206-14855.creator: Mohit Singhal 1 Chen Ling 2 Pujan Paudel 2 Poojitha Thota 1 Nihal Kumarswamy 1, Gianluca Stringhini 2 Shirin Nilizadeh 1
arxiv-2206-14855.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mohit Singhal 1 Chen Ling 2 Pujan Paudel 2 Poojitha Thota 1 Nihal Kumarswamy 1, Gianluca Stringhini 2 Shirin Nilizadeh 1. Social media platforms have been establishing content moderation guidelines and employing various moderation policies to counter hate speech and misinformation.

arxiv-2208-01532.title: Comparing Hermitian and Non-Hermitian Quantum Electrodynamics
arxiv-2208-01532.creator: Jake Southall, Daniel Hodgson, Robert Purdy and Almut Beige
arxiv-2208-01532.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jake Southall, Daniel Hodgson, Robert Purdy and Almut Beige. In recent years, non-Hermitian quantum physics has gained a lot in popularity in the quantum optics and condensed matter communities in order to model quantum systems with varying symmetries. In this paper, we identify a non-standard inner product that implies bosonic commutator relations for local electric and magnetic field observables and leads to a natural local biorthogonal description of the quantised electromagnetic field.

arxiv-2304-06617.title: Exact and lower bounds for the quantum speed limit in finite dimensional systems
arxiv-2304-06617.creator: Mattias T. Johnsson, Lauritz van Luijk, Daniel Burgarth
arxiv-2304-06617.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mattias T. Johnsson, Lauritz van Luijk, Daniel Burgarth. A fundamental problem in quantum engineering is determining the lowest time required to ensure that all possible unitaries can be generated with the tools available, which is one of a number of possible quantum speed limits . We examine this problem from the perspective of quantum control, where the system of interest is described by a drift Hamiltonian and set of control Hamiltonians.

arxiv-2305-03141.title: Dynamical Exclusion of Probability and Energy Conservation
arxiv-2305-03141.creator: Victor Atanasov
arxiv-2305-03141.description: Abstract The interrelationship between energy and probability conservation is explored from the point of view of statistical physics and non-relativistic quantum mechanics. The simultaneous validity of the law of conservation of energy and the continuity equation (probability conservation) breaks for an interacting dynamical system.

arxiv-2310-00762.title: A note on the stabilizer formalism via noncommutative graphs
arxiv-2310-00762.creator: Roy Araiza, Jihong Cai, Yushan Chen, Abraham Holtermann, Chieh Hsu, Tushar Mohan, Peixue Wu, Zeyuan Yu
arxiv-2310-00762.description: Abstract In this short note we formulate a stablizer formalism in the language of noncommutative graphs. The classes of noncommutative graphs we consider are obtained via unitary representations of finite groups, and suitably chosen operators on finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces. Furthermore, in this framework, we generalize previous results in this area for determining when such noncommutative graphs have anticliques.

arxiv-2310-08313.title: Real phase structures on tropical varieties and patchworks in higher codimension
arxiv-2310-08313.creator: Johannes Rau, Arthur Renaudineau, Kris Shaw
arxiv-2310-08313.description: Abstract . This paper generalises the homeomorphism theorem behind Viro’s combinatorial patchworking of hypersurfaces in toric varieties to arbitrary codimension using tropical geometry. We first define the patchwork of a polyhedral space equipped with a real phase structure. When the polyhedral subspace is tropically non-singular, we show that the patchwork is a topological manifold.

arxiv-2311-15448.title: GGNNs : Generalizing GNNs using Residual Connections and Weighted Message Passing
arxiv-2311-15448.creator: Abhinav Raghuvanshi, Kushal S M
arxiv-2311-15448.description: Abstract Many real-world phenomena can be modeled as a graph, making them extremely valuable due to their ubiquitous presence. GNNs excel at capturing those relationships and pat- terns within these graphs, enabling effective learning and prediction tasks. GNNs are constructed using Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) and incorporate additional layers for message passing to facilitate the flow of features among nodes.

arxiv-2312-07189.title: Charge-conserving equilibration of quantum Hall edge states
arxiv-2312-07189.creator: Edvin G. Idrisov, Ivan P. Levkivskyi, Eugene V. Sukhorukov
arxiv-2312-07189.description: Abstract We address the experimentally relevant situation, where a non-equilibrium state is created by injecting charge current into a chiral quantum Hall edge state. We show that the commonly accepted picture of the full equilibration of a non-equilibrium state at finite distances contradicts to the charge conservation requirement.

arxiv-2404-02081.title: Explainability in JupyterLab and Beyond: Interactive XAI Systems for Integrated and Collaborative Workflows Conference: CHI Workshop on Human-Notebook Interactions; May 11–16, 2024; Honolulu, HI, USA CCS: Human-centered computing Visualization systems and tools CCS: Human-centered computing Visual a
arxiv-2404-02081.creator: Grace Guo, Dustin Arendt, Alex Endert
arxiv-2404-02081.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Grace Guo, Dustin Arendt, Alex Endert. Explainable AI (XAI) tools represent a turn to more human-centered and human-in-the-loop AI approaches that emphasize user needs and perspectives in machine learning model development workflows. However, while the majority of ML resources available today are developed for Python computational environments such as JupyterLab and Jupyter Notebook, the same has not been true of interactive XAI systems, which are often still implemented as standalone interfaces.

arxiv-2405-06750.title: Scalar Field Dominated Cosmology with Woods-Saxon Like Potential
arxiv-2405-06750.creator: Sreerag Radhakrishnan, Sarath Nelleri, Navaneeth Poonthottathil
arxiv-2405-06750.description: Abstract Dark energy can be characterized by a canonical scalar field, known as quintessence. Quintessence allows for a dynamical equation of state − 1 ≤ ω ≤ − 1 3 -1\leq\omega\leq-\frac{1}{3} . A previous study by Oikonomou and Chatzarakis have shown that a scalar field model with a Woods-Saxon like potential can successfully explain the early inflation.

arxiv-2406-08816.title: ToSA: Token Selective Attention for Efficient Vision Transformers
arxiv-2406-08816.creator: Manish Kumar Singh Rajeev Yasarla Hong Cai Mingu Lee Fatih Porikli, Qualcomm AI Research {masi, ryasarla, hongcai, mingul, fporikli}@qti.qualcomm.com
arxiv-2406-08816.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Manish Kumar Singh Rajeev Yasarla Hong Cai Mingu Lee Fatih Porikli, Qualcomm AI Research {masi, ryasarla, hongcai, mingul, fporikli}@qti.qualcomm.com. In this paper, we propose a novel token selective attention approach, ToSA, which can identify tokens that need to be attended as well as those that can skip a transformer layer.

arxiv-2412-09676.title: OGLE-2015-BLG-1609Lb: Sub-jovian planet orbiting a low-mass stellar or brown dwarf host
arxiv-2412-09676.creator: M. J. Mróz, R. Poleski, A. Udalski, T. Sumi, Y. Tsapras, M. Hundertmark (Leading Authors) P. Pietrukowicz, M. K. Szymański, J. Skowron, P. Mróz, M. Gromadzki, P. Iwanek, S. Kozłowski, M. Ratajczak, K. A. Rybicki, D. M. Skowron, I. Soszyński, K. Ulaczyk, M. Wrona (OGLE Collaboration) F. Abe, K. Bando
arxiv-2412-09676.description: Abstract We present a comprehensive analysis of a planetary microlensing event OGLE-2015-BLG-1609. The planetary anomaly was detected by two survey telescopes, OGLE and MOA. Each of these surveys collected enough data over the planetary anomaly to allow for an unambiguous planet detection.

arxiv-2502-09380.title: Beilinson’s conjecture on K3 surfaces with an involution
arxiv-2502-09380.creator: Kalyan Banerjee
arxiv-2502-09380.description: Abstract . In this note, we prove that the Beilinson conjecture holds for certain examples of K3 surfaces over ℚ ¯ \bar{\mathbb{Q}} equipped with an involution, when the quotient of the surface by the involution is the projective plane branched along a sextic. 1.

arxiv-2508-20282.title: Network-Level Prompt and Trait Leakage in Local Research Agents
arxiv-2508-20282.creator: Hyejun Jeong, Mohammadreza Teymoorianfard, Abhinav Kumar, Eugene Bagdasarian
arxiv-2508-20282.description: Abstract We show that Web and Research Agents (WRAs)—language model-based systems that investigate complex topics on the Internet—are vulnerable to inference attacks by passive network adversaries such as ISPs. These agents could be deployed locally by organizations and individuals for privacy, legal, or financial purposes.

pmc-10557853.title: Single‐nucleotide polymorphism at alcohol dehydrogenase 1B: A susceptible gene marker in oro‐/hypopharyngeal cancers from genome‐wide association study
pmc-10557853.creator: Hui‐Tzu Chien, Chia‐Lung Tsai, Chi‐Kuan Young, Yun‐Shien Lee, Chun‐Ta Liao, Chih‐Ching Yeh, Angel Chao, Kai‐Lun Cho, Ching‐Han Chen, Shiang‐Fu Huang
pmc-10557853.description: IntroductionIn the era of precision preventive medicine, susceptible genetic markers for oro‐/hypopharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) have been investigated for genome‐wide associations.Materials and MethodsA case–control study including 659 male head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) patients, including 331 oropharyngeal cancer, treated between March 1996 and December 2016 and 2400 normal controls was performed.

pmc-10596379.title: Digital Public Health in Slovenia
pmc-10596379.creator: R Hrzic
pmc-10596379.description: The digitalisation of the Slovene healthcare system began in the mid-2000s with the publication of the eHealth 2010 strategy. However, it was not until 2016 that the digitalisation process gained significant momentum with the adoption of the Resolution on the National Health Care Plan 2016-2025 and the conclusion of the pilot phase of the eHealth project.

pmc-10704671.title: Tecnologias educacionais utilizadas para promoção do autocuidado de pessoas com diabetes mellitus: revisão integrativa
pmc-10704671.creator: Jennyfer Soares de Sá, Martin Dharlle Oliveira Santana, Mayara Góes dos Santos, Júnior Cesar de Souza Benedito, Elen Ferraz Teston
pmc-10704671.description: Objective:To summarize the scientific productions that used educational technologies to promote self-care for people with diabetes.Method:Integrative review carried out from October 2022 to January 2023, in the databases: LILACS; Scopus; Embase; PubMed/MEDLINE and CINAHL. The search was paired, and the sample consisted of ten articles.

pmc-12579617.title: The Impact of Top-Down Attention on Emotion Ensemble Perception: Fear-Guided Attention Leads to Cautious Decisions
pmc-12579617.creator: Hilary H. T. Ngai, Jingwen Jin
pmc-12579617.description: Accurately deducing the emotional tenor of our visual surroundings has important repercussions, such as whether to approach a friendly group or flee a threatening mob. Perceptual decisions regarding individual emotional stimuli are heavily influenced by both task-driven (top-down) and stimulus-driven (bottom-up) attention.

pmc-13570350.description: To address the poor water solubility and high volatility of eugenol (EU), this study developed an EU nanoemulsion (NanoEU) and evaluated its anti-Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium (S. Typhimurium) activity and protective effects against S. Typhimurium infection in vitro and in vivo. NanoEU showed a uniform milky-white appearance, an average particle size of 137.53 ± 5.

uslaw-usc-t16-s689.title: 16 U.S.C. § 689 — Tahquitz National Game Preserve
uslaw-usc-t16-s689.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s689.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 6 (Game And Bird Preserves; Protection). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. There is created within the San Bernardino National Forest in Riverside County, California, for the protection of game animals, and as the recognized breeding place therefor, the Tahquitz National Game Preserve, which shall include the following lands: Sections 28, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33.
